analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Widely
analysis.quote: Your Data may be disclosed to us by our Commercial Partners and be shared with us by our selected Commercial Partners.

analysis.headline: Trains AI on Your Data
analysis.quote: Some of Your Data may be disclosed to some of our Data Partners for further use of fostering AI development.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Third-Party Data
analysis.quote: We may receive information about You from some of our Data Partners. Your Data may be disclosed to us by our Commercial Partners and be shared with us by our selected Commercial Partners.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Precise Location
analysis.quote: We may collect Your device’s location data (limited to the city level only).

analysis.headline: Cannot Opt Out of Ads
analysis.quote: NOT CONSENTING TO PROCESSING OF YOUR DATA WILL NOT ELIMINATE OR LIMIT THE NUMBER OF ADS YOU ARE SHOWN; IT MAY SIMPLY RESULT IN ADS WHICH ARE MORE REPETITIVE AND LIKELY LESS INTERESTING TO YOU.

analysis.headline: Retains Your Data Legally
analysis.quote: as a content hosting platform, we are legally required to keep certain limited information about our Users and, if conditions defined by the applicable laws are met, share it with competent public authorities.

analysis.headline: Partners Control Your Data
analysis.quote: Our Commercial Partners are independent Data Controllers when they (or their respective Data Processors) process Your Personal Data for purposes that they define independently and using the means they determine.

analysis.headline: Combines Your Data Sources
analysis.quote: We may combine the shared information with the information we collect from or about You and use it in the manner described in Section 3 of the Privacy Policy or as otherwise permitted by law.

analysis.headline: Monitors Your Uploaded Content
analysis.quote: For example, we may use AI-based tools as part of our Content moderation process to detect suspicious content... but the decision about whether or not to take down a given Content is eventually always taken by a human moderator and subject to Your right to appeal.
